extracted.name: Mango Smoothie
extracted.description: This mango smoothie has an amazing creamy texture and sweet, tangy tropical flavor. Made with 5 simple ingredients, it's an easy, delicious breakfast or healthy snack.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups diced frozen mango (plus a few thawed cubes for garnish)
1 cup unsweetened almond milk (or any milk, plus more as needed)
½ cup whole milk Greek yogurt*
Fresh mint or basil leaves (optional, for garnish)
instruction_lines: In a high-speed blender, place the mango, banana, almond milk, yogurt, and lime juice.
Blend until smooth, adding more almond milk as needed to blend. Pour into glasses, garnish with diced mango and fresh mint, if using, and serve.
